title: geo/changed/v1
description: A version of a CIS dataset this USSP installed (brief WP-12; 2021/664 Art. 9): published by api on cis.v1.<dataset> once the version is installed, projected to cis_current and stored, and forwarded by traffic-ws to every subscription as the geo change push, so an operator client or the portal refetches GET /v1/geo. feature_ids are the identifiers of the features added, removed or changed; truncated says the list was cut at its bound and every feature of the dataset is to be taken as changed. reason is installed, or warm_start when api loaded the version from its store at a start (nothing is known of what changed meanwhile: every feature is listed). It names what changed, never what to do.
